changes: An independent reader marked the version 3 sheet and found real faults, which are listed here plainly. Reasons: S02 said the 4-month total of 8,000 rupees was put in this month. S07, S09 and S12 said this month took the value below what was put in when it was already below. S16 was in Hinglish on an English row and added a cause the facts do not show. S14 said 'not quite' to a wrong guess. S04 called a 1.7% fall close to a 3.1% fall. S15, S18 and S05 had loose or added wording. The number check could not see S02 because 8,000 was in the facts. Questions: A07 asked for small, mid and large cap and only small was answered. A06, A17 and A20 called an exit load of about 358 rupees this fund's. A11 gave a loose Nifty 50 definition tagged as the person's numbers. A14 and A19 gave numbers with no reason. A16 compared one period only. Changes since version 3: (1) The reason is written by code for every case and language and the AI is not called for it. The 4 reason templates were re-read. The closeness rule now needs the gap to be at most a third of the bigger fall, a wrong market guess gets 'The market is not the reason this month', and the market-rose case no longer calls the fall the fund's own reason. (2) Refusals for advice and for the future are one short line each plus the small pointer, and the question is not discussed. Predictions have their own line and wider phrase patterns. (3) Fund-type answers only explain what the name means, with no percentages and nothing about where a fund invests, and a question naming several types answers all of them. (4) The Nifty 50 and exit load definitions, 'why is my value below' and 'fund against the market' are answered by code from fixed text and the facts. (5) The follow-up prompt says totals are never this month's and never says this fund charges an exit load. (6) A new check flags the total invested described as this month's. The golden questions, labels, pass lines and earlier reports were not edited.
